_meta.name: Trooth Pre-Flight Control Catalog
_meta.note: Checks run against a resolved Terraform plan (terraform show -json). Each check maps a code-defined infrastructure control to recognized frameworks and ships a Fix-It remediation snippet. Advisory only — Trooth never applies changes; the engineer merges the suggested patch.

checks.title: S3 bucket must enforce server-side encryption
checks.rationale: Unencrypted object storage exposes data at rest if the bucket is compromised.
checks.fix: Add a aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resource (AES256 or aws:kms) for this bucket.

checks.title: S3 bucket must block public access
checks.rationale: Publicly readable/writable buckets are the #1 cause of cloud data breaches.
checks.fix: Set ACL to private and add aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block with all four block_* flags = true.

checks.title: RDS instance must be encrypted at rest
checks.rationale: Unencrypted databases expose all stored records if the storage layer is accessed.
checks.fix: Set storage_encrypted = true (and optionally kms_key_id) on the aws_db_instance.

checks.title: RDS instance must not be publicly accessible
checks.rationale: A publicly reachable database is exposed to the entire internet.
checks.fix: Set publicly_accessible = false and place the instance in private subnets.

checks.title: EBS volume must be encrypted
checks.rationale: Unencrypted block storage exposes data at rest.
checks.fix: Set encrypted = true on the aws_ebs_volume.

checks.title: Security group must not expose SSH/RDP to the world
checks.rationale: 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on ports 22 (SSH) or 3389 (RDP) invites brute-force and lateral movement.
checks.fix: Restrict the ingress CIDR to known admin ranges or a bastion/VPN; remove 0.0.0.0/0 on 22/3389.

checks.title: IAM policy must not grant Action:* on Resource:*
checks.rationale: Wildcard admin grants violate least-privilege and turn any credential leak into full account compromise.
checks.fix: Scope the policy to the specific actions and resource ARNs the workload needs.

checks.title: Load balancer listener must use HTTPS/TLS
checks.rationale: Plain HTTP listeners transmit data unencrypted in transit.
checks.fix: Set protocol = "HTTPS" (port 443) with an ACM certificate_arn, and redirect HTTP→HTTPS.

checks.title: CloudWatch log group should be encrypted
checks.rationale: Logs can contain sensitive data and should be encrypted with a KMS key.
